# Daily Dashboard V0.4

## Release scope

- Added application-wide display scaling at 75%, 100%, 125%, 150%, and 200%.
- Fixed the Settings panel bounds and scrolling so its top, bottom, and controls remain accessible at every scale.
- Restored single-row dashboard packing: four to six visible widgets are assigned to the existing three columns instead of creating another full dashboard row.
- Fixed the ADS-B map so it fills the remaining aircraft-widget height instead of rendering as a short strip.
- Added dark monochrome/colour toggles to the ADS-B and weather-radar maps.
- Extended base-map zoom to level 19 while safely overzooming RainViewer's level-7 radar tiles, preventing the previous “zoom level not supported” failure.
- Fixed erratic ADS-B and weather-map panning by converting rendered pointer movement into scale-aware logical map pixels and advancing from the latest map centre on every move.
- Added the live ADS-B aircraft widget with selectable aircraft, registration, altitude, speed, graphic-only mode, and an interactive mouse/touch map.
- Added a second Weather widget page with interactive RainViewer radar.
- Fixed Outlook iCalendar recurrence expansion, exclusions, edited occurrences, and cancellations.
- Updated the application, package, Rust crate, Tauri binary, Settings display, tests, documentation, and Windows workflows from V0.3 / 0.3.0 to V0.4 / 0.4.0.

## Windows 10 portable executable

- File: `V0.4_Daily-Dashboard.exe`
- Target: `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`
- Format: PE32+ Windows GUI executable
- Size: approximately 12 MB
- SHA-256: `baa92ed99e711c17d95f48a33db182f435d980525b1404ca1289d399714a9cb7`
- Build command: `npm run tauri:build -- --runner cargo-xwin --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --no-bundle`

The Tauri CLI production path is required because it enables `tauri/custom-protocol` and embeds the compiled frontend. Calling `cargo xwin build` directly creates a development-mode executable that attempts to connect to the Vite server and fails with `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED` on another computer.

Windows 10 requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which is normally installed by Windows servicing or Microsoft Edge. The portable executable does not install WebView2 itself.

## Verification

- `npm test`
- `npm run build`
- `cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml`
- Settings panel geometry verified at all five supported scales on a short ultrawide viewport, including scrolling the Save controls into view at 200%.
- Four-, five-, and six-widget layouts were verified without dashboard overflow; the six-widget layout was checked at 75%, 100%, 125%, 150%, and 200%.
- Map UX smoke tests passed at exactly 1280×480 and 1920×720, covering map height, dashboard containment, monochrome toggles, and weather zoom beyond RainViewer level 7.
- Pointer-drag smoke tests passed at 1280×400, 1280×480, and 1920×720, including outward/reverse drags on both maps and an additional ADS-B drag at 200% application scaling.
- Live-provider verification returned current aircraft around Melbourne from ADSB.lol and current radar-frame metadata from RainViewer.
- Windows cross-compilation completed with the MSVC target.
- The final artifact was verified as an x86-64 PE32+ Windows GUI executable and checksummed.
